brief.zh: 完成 shelf_alert_count(shelves, limit)。用 row_total 计算每排的合计，再用 count_alerts 数出合计达到预警线的排数。
brief.en: Complete shelf_alert_count(shelves, limit). Use row_total to total each row and count_alerts to count how many row totals reach the alert threshold.

concept.zh: 把一个函数的结果整理成另一个函数的输入
concept.en: Collect one function’s results to use as another function’s input

hints.zh: 从空列表 totals 开始，遍历货架并把各排合计追加进去。
hints.en: Start totals as an empty list. Visit each shelf row and append its total.

hints.zh: 最后调用 count_alerts(totals, limit)。每个等于预警线的合计也算一次。
hints.en: Call count_alerts(totals, limit) at the end. A total equal to the threshold also counts.

hints.zh: 你也可以从 my_algorithms 导入已保存的同名 row_total。
hints.en: You can import your saved row_total of the same name from my_algorithms.
